Lucan decided to keep this secret and train the saint so that in the future, he could have an easy life and save himself from any crises.
leveling-up-with-my-pet:
Step into the extraordinary world of Liu Yong, where transmigration and leveling up collide unexpectedly. Imagine waking up one day to find yourself in someone else's body but with a remarkable companion. Liu Yong's mutant snapping turtle possesses the power to level up its features, unlocking incredible abilities that enhance Liu Yong's life beyond measure.
With each level up, Liu Yong's bond with his magical pet grows more assertive, and their combined power becomes unstoppable. But it's not just about personal growth - Liu Yong's newfound abilities also open up possibilities for his business ventures. With the help of his pet, he could expand his enterprise and amass a fortune beyond his wildest dreams.
So, what would you do if you found yourself in Liu Yong's shoes? How would you use a leveling-up pet's power to transform your existence? The possibilities are endless, and the journey is yours to embark upon. Are you ready to discover what lies beyond the boundaries of your imagination?
lingering-doting-marriage-big-boss-littl:
In front of others, he is a cold and callous President of an empire. Young, wealthy and handsome, he is also the Prince Charming in every woman’s heart.
Only Chi Enen knows how temperamental, domineering and possessive he is!
Five years ago, Chi Enen left him and disappeared without a trace. Now, she bumped into him coincidentally and he refuses to let her go.
After their reencounter, he bounds Chi Enen mercilessly to his side. If she is out of his sight for a moment, his paranoia will be triggered…
“I gave in to you in the past because I can’t bear not to. Now, I have already decided to do it my way. I don’t need your agreement.”
“Li Beijue, what do you want from me?”
“I just want you to fall in love with me!”
Chi Enen struggles to get out of his clutches and at the same time, fighting desperately to resist his charm.
Will he discover the truth of what happened five years ago?
lord-of-the-red-planet:
In 2025, Avalon the most legendary MMORPG that had reigned for two decades, announced it would shut down its servers on July 12th.
Rian, the Guild Master of Avanheim, decides to stay loyal until the very end, accompanying his guild in the Throne Room of Avanheim Castle until the servers are completely shut down.
However, when the final second passes, a miracle occurs. He isn't forcibly logged out by the system. Instead, he remains within Avanheim. The NPCs, once mere programs, begin to show consciousness, and the digital world feels entirely real.
It seems he has been summoned to another world, just like in the fantasy novels he so often reads.
This time, Rian swears to himself: he will no longer be a loser. In this new world, he will become a winner.
To establish an empire. To conquer the world. This is the beginning of the Great Path of Conquest.
...Or maybe he'll just keep a low profile and live in peace?

When they met at the kindergarten again, the boy was glad that the girl had no longer remembered the previous incident. However, getting close to her was not an easy task as the girl was always surrounded by others who admired her.
Once the boy finally got the girl’s attention, his family decided to move to another country.
Years later, the two of them crossed paths again. This time, the boy pulled the girl’s hand, heading straight to the Civil Affairs Bureau.
Holding a newly registered red book and meeting her gaze, the corner of his lips finally turned up as he finally got her absolute attention.
loveexe-surviving-a-cyberpunk-death-game:
Proxy has a simple philosophy about life.
Avoid trouble. Avoid fights. Avoid people who look like they enjoy either of those things.
Unfortunately, Proxy also has Nyx.
They grew up together. Stayed together. Drifted through the same corners of the city long enough that everyone eventually assumed they were a package deal.
Proxy assumed the same thing.
What he did not assume was that Nyx had reached a conclusion about him.
A very simple conclusion.
If someone threatens Proxy, they shouldn't exist anymore.
Proxy, of course, doesn't know that.
Not yet.
Up until now, Nyx has been normal. Mostly normal. A little quiet. A little intense.
That illusion lasts right up until the night they both found themselves on a tropical island with fighting for their lives.
Welcome to the Corporate Death Game.
Thirty-Six contestants.
One island.
Only the survivors get to leave.
Proxy plans to survive by hiding behind a terminal, breaking a few systems, and staying far away from the violence.
Nyx has a different plan.
Because if everyone else on the island dies, Proxy will be perfectly safe.
And now Proxy knows.
martial-dao-peace-by-force:

modern-my-broken-sign-in-system:
Being isekai'd into another world was the dream of every anime and light novel fan.
Ben was no exception.
He had spent countless nights imagining himself awakening in a fantasy world filled with magic, monsters, beautiful companions, and limitless adventures. So when death finally came, he believed his wish had been granted.
Except...
“What the hell is this?!”
Ben stared at the familiar skyline before him in disbelief.
“This is just Earth!”
Well... almost.
The only obvious difference was its name.
Earth was now called Solar-3.
The countries, history, technology, and society all appeared identical to the world he had left behind.
Just as disappointment set in, a mechanical voice echoed in his mind.
[Sign-In System Activated.]
Ben's eyes lit up.
“At least I can become a billionaire with this.”
His excitement lasted exactly one second.
[Congratulations! You have signed in and obtained: Fireball Spell.]
“...”
“...What?”
“There isn't even mana in this world! How the hell am I supposed to cast magic?!”
modern-world-warlock:
Dante was an ageless warlock who had been going from one battle to another for hundreds of years.
Following a chaotic encounter with an evil god, Dante unintentionally activates a contract with a demon, thrusting him into the modern world.
Resolved to live a peaceful life, his intentions are halted when he finds himself in the middle of a conflict among rival mafia factions—dabbling with the ominous demonic magic that he knows best.
murim-psychopath:
[Welcome to Murim Online, the world where the strongest reside.]

my-girlfriend-is-very-good-to-me:

my-homes-ancient-well-connects-to-the-ma:
Ye Xing returns to his hometown for a blind date, happens to encounter a Nine-Thunder Shocking Thunder, and discovers that the ancient well in the backyard of his ancestral home can actually lead to the otherworldly Martial Arts Continent.
Thus, he comes and goes, traveling between the two worlds, selling mobile phones, learning Martial Arts, and starts his awesome life.
On the Martial Arts Continent, he is a great tycoon, establishes the White Cloud Manor, recruits heroes from all corners, and commands a powerful, modernized Martial Artist army.
On Earth, he is a big boss, a philanthropist, and even more so, a Martial Arts Master hidden in the city.

plundering-women-in-the-multiverse:
David, reborn into the world of Resident Evil, accidentally killed a reincarnator and activated the system that had always been inactive within him.
From that moment on, he embarked on a path of plundering beauties and wealth, traveling across different worlds of movies, games, and anime.

primordial-lust-system:

But fate has other plans. One encounter with a heavenly beauty awakens a secret power that lets him steal talents, bodies, and destinies through pleasure.
Now armed with godlike looks and a hunger for power, Aurelian will rise through brothels, dungeons, and empires, proving that lust can rewrite destiny.
reborn-the-tyrants-obsession:
Waking up in the middle of that, she nearly screamed—until she saw him.
Her cold, obsessive husband. The man she had spent an entire lifetime running from.
In her past life, she trusted the wrong people. She abandoned the man who truly loved her and ended up betrayed, ruined, and dead.
This time? Ha! Divorce? Dream on.

reincarnated-as-an-npc-in-my-own-game:
In a future where the line between reality and virtual reality is all but erased, RPG games reign supreme. A young programmer, driven by an intense urge to escape poverty and an unwavering dream, pours his soul into creating Bloodbound Ascension, a ruthless online game.
But his journey ends tragically when exhaustion claims his life, only for him to awaken within his own creation as an NPC trapped in one of its deadliest Towers.
Armed with the knowledge of every trap, secret, and monster, he must navigate the brutal world he designed, struggling to survive against other NPCs and the merciless mechanics of Bloodbound Ascension.
In a realm where the line between creator and creation no longer exists, can he rewrite his fate, or will his masterpiece become his tomb?
rise-of-the-alchemy-god:
Ethan finds himself mysteriously transported to another world, where the strong reign and the weak perish.
Welcomed by a kind farmer who decides to help him upon seeing his poor condition, Ethan begins to hope for a new life.
However, his dream is shattered when an acquaintance deceives him, leading to his sale at the slave market. Desperate and confused, Ethan wonders what he has done to deserve all this.
“Which deity have I offended to deserve all this?”
Just when he thinks all is lost, fate has another surprise in store for him, once again changing the course of his destiny.
samsara-online:
In the year 2030, Samsara Online, a 100% immersive VRMMORPG that allows players to bring their innate real-world skills to the virtual world, is launched and supported by the World Central Bank.
With terrifying analytical ability, inhuman reflexes, and monstrous reaction speed, Xie Feng’s travel starts into a world that he will gradually discover is not as normal as it seems.
It was also from that moment that Xie Feng’s life started to deviate from the norm, changing his destiny completely.

Master Nine imagines that the person he brought back is a silly little girl.…

Drazeil: Genie of the Infernal Realm
with vampire blood—a hybrid who
grants wishes for a bloody price.
The feared illegitimate son of the crown. The King’s deadliest weapon. The Crown's Monster, everyone whisper about.
Cold. Ruthless. Untouchable.
And a man who hates Celestial Beings more than anything.
To him, celestials are not gods—they are liars wrapped in divinity. The reason his Infernal Realm bled. The reason monsters like him were created.
To rebuild his Infernal Realm, he will tear Heaven itself apart.
Far from the Realms, Celestia lived a simple and happy life in the Mortal Realm, peaceful, ordinary, and untouched by the darkness of kingdoms and gods. Until the day everything changed.
A single moment.
A pull she could not explain.…
the-heiress-revenge:
Angelo thought he could throw me away? Bella thought she could take everything from me?
They were wrong. So wrong.
Every single thing Angelo had his job in the Melendez Corp, his money, his fancy life, I gave him that.
I would take everything from them.

Now, I was back.

Ariana Melendez, a hidden heiress, thought she had the perfect life until her husband Angelo and best friend Bella betrayed her in the worst way. After losing everything, including her unborn child, she returns to her powerful family, burning with revenge. To punish her, her father arranges a marriage with Dante Russo, the ruthless son of a business rival. Dante Russo, the cold, calculating heir of their greatest enemy and Angelo’s Uncle one that could destroy her ex-husband with a single word. Now, Ariana is trapped in a dangerous game. On one side her vow to ruin Angelo and Bella to make them suffer as she did. On the other her forced marriage to Dante, a man as ruthless as he is intoxicating, whose loyalty is as uncertain as her own heart.
the-little-brats-sweet-and-sassy:
The entire Yunzhou knew that the Ye Family had a new step-child in the house: Ning Li, a low-born and barely literate. However, when she looked at her 17 years old self in the mirror after coming back to life, she grinned.
At 17, her step-siblings had yet destroyed her looks and stolen her glory—she still had everything with her. Since she was given an opportunity to start over, she ought to take revenge on everyone who had wronged her before. It would be interesting.
After Ning Li was chased out of the Ye Family, she was cherished by the most popular solo singer in the entertainment industry, protected by the top international racer, courted by the heir to a multimillion corporation, and loved by her billionaire grandfather who wanted her to inherit the family business.
Even Second Master Lu said to her, “Hold up you little brat, I think you should come home with me.”
Rumor had it that Second Master Lu was handsome and beyond any girl’s reach until that one fateful day, when someone saw a drawing of a cool and proud young boy with bangs covering his eyes fall out from Second Master Lu’s book.…
the-retired-abyss-innkeeper:
[ Late check-ins accepted. Abyss residues surcharges apply. ]
The Last Neutral Inn, a small establishment run by a retired man named Aldous. He serves good soup, honest tea, and the only guaranteed neutral ground between the mortal world and the Abyss.
He used to change the world. He doesn't do that anymore, but he has opinions about bread. He will share them.
In a place where exiled gods need somewhere to sleep, demon courts require neutral venues for negotiations they can't afford to lose, and abyssal entities older than civilization occasionally need a simple word with someone who won't panic, Aldous runs the only establishment that qualifies. His guests aren't only human. His inn shouldn't exist. The Abyss stops exactly at his property line, which nobody has satisfactorily explained.
Aldous makes soup. He fixes the stairs. He files the paperwork.
He is no hero. No king. He runs an inn.
The question nobody had the courage to ask yet is why.

Ye Xingguang, dumped on the day of her graduation, stormed to the civil department to get in the queue for matchmaking, and somehow got Ye Junqing, the billionaire who topped the Forbes Rich list?
Everyone was saying that Ye Junqing also topped the list of celibates, and Ye Xingguang had expected that he would be difficult to get along with.

the-ultimate-experience-system:
“She betrayed me. Lied to me. Left me for a richer man...

Just as he's drowning in heartbreak, a mysterious voice echoes in his mind:
“System has found the perfect host. Binding initiated.”
Now, with a powerful system in his hands—one that grants him experience in any skill he desires—Chen Yu embarks on a journey of transformation.
He doesn’t want revenge.
He wants greatness.
From rock bottom to the very top, Chen Yu will rise.
And those who once looked down on him?
They’ll wish they never did.
He will have to rise to the top of the world before the EVENT comes.

“Rishe Ilmgard Wertsner! I’m breaking off my engagement with you!”
“Okay, I understand.”
“Huh.”
The Duke’s daughter, Rishe left the evening party without delay.
In fact, for Rishe, this engagement has been terminated for the seventh time. That’s where her new life starts, after having enjoyed the way of life of a pharmacist and a dressed up knight, she lost her life at the age of 20 and has gone back to the scene where her engagement was broken off.

Her past six lives have been busy and fulfilling, she wants to live longer this time around.

Hundreds of years ago, a colossal comet struck the southern continent and spewed out a deadly virus that brought the world to the brink of destruction.
The surviving humans sought refuge behind the walls or a steel fortress of the remaining civilizations.
However, in the midst of a world decaying with metal and blood, a mysterious boy suddenly wakes up from his slumber.
His name is Cain, an ordinary boy trapped in a reality that is not his own.
Under a perpetual neon sky, Cain must struggle to survive, facing a new world filled with cruel fate and the horrors of terror that lurk beyond the iron walls.
Then, when despair almost consumed him, a system window appeared before him.

A whisper of emptiness offered him salvation, which demanded a price from him.

At 26, Portuguese footballer Tobi Oliveira ended his life, crushed by regret and failure. But fate gives him a second chance—sending him ten years back to when he was just 16, with a mysterious football system and all the memories of his past.
Now, with raw talent, real hunger, and the unwavering support of his mother-agent and football-loving little sister, Tobi is determined to rewrite his story. From Sporting CP to Valencia’s first team, he must juggle brutal training, school, media pressure, and the emotional weight of his past life.
But success doesn’t come easy. His stats drop in the pros. Not every match ends in victory. And greatness demands more than just skill—it demands heart.
